correctness.rationale: Every monic cubic mod p has one of five disjoint factorization types; reduction counts sum p^3. Hensel splitting of a distinct simple factor plus double root gives uniform discriminant modulo p^3, with 0,p,2p additional roots; triple reductions give 0,p,p^2 through p-adic digit conditions. The weighted PGF includes exactly root-count support {0,1,3,p,p+1,2p+1,p^2} (collisions at 3), P(R=p^2)=p^-5 and the stated fourth moment. Independent exhaustive enumeration of all 3^9=19683 monic cubics modulo 27 reproduced histogram {0:7452,1:9963,3:1215,4:486,7:486,9:81}. Separate rational differentiation at p=3,5,7,11 gave the claimed fourth-moment polynomial. General proof uses factorization and Hensel, not only finite enumeration.
